name: still
doc: A held real image, edge to edge, on a slow linear push (REF-1/2: every still breathes).

name: frames
doc: Show a list of pre-rendered frames one (or `per`) frame each: the 3-4 frame datamosh.

name: tile_reveal
doc:
REF-1's opening move: the thirds grid; each pane flashes white for one frame and
then shows the new picture, one pane per frame in a shuffled order, one click per pane.
The layer ends when the last pane lands; put the full still underneath from `t`.

name: captions
doc:
Small white words, centred, each appearing on its own spoken onset (+-1 frame,
measured), laid out in their final slots so nothing re-centres. groups = list of
(words, t_end) where words = [(text, onset), ...].

name: keyword
doc:
The big word. kind = key (white sans) | shock (red Didone caps) | title (chrome serif
italic). Blur-in over 6 frames (REF-1 "Valley"); the shock word cuts on hard.
text may be a list: one display line each, stacked left-aligned (a long ID behind a
head reads better as two short lines than as one occluded one).

name: svg_mark
doc: A real brand mark (the company's own SVG), white, blurred in like a keyword.

name: pop_collage
doc:
REF-2's opening: real cards land one by one on a dark ground, each preceded by a
one-frame white box of its own size, one click each. cards = [(src, x, y, w, rot, t_pop)]
(x, y = card centre). The whole stack drifts in slowly.

name: wall3d
doc:
REF-1 41.4-45.3s: a perspective plane covered in real cards, the camera sweeping
across it with motion blur. tiles = list of srcs, laid on a grid and repeated to fill.

name: paper_card
doc:
REF-1 8.2-9.0s: a small real card on the grey-vignetted paper ground, the spoken
words flanking it in ink, the card creeping larger. Opens on an invert flash
(the paper reads black for `invert_in` frames, REF-2 f503).

name: strobe
doc:
REF-2 83.2-84.6s: one word carried by a burst of images, 2-3 frames each, a small
white square hopping between them. One tick per image.

name: focus_card
doc:
A real card filling most of the frame, opening defocused and racking sharp over
12 frames (REF-1 9.9s). mark = (x, y, w, h, t) highlighter on the card in CARD px.

name: terminal
doc:
A rebuilt API call: the command types, the response streams up, and stops with the
rows that matter centred; markers sweep across them one per tick (REF-1's PayPal
receipt is the same move: a real interface, rebuilt, timed to the words).

name: typewriter
doc:
REF-2 51.8s "with no ▮": text typing on black behind a white block cursor, with
broken scanlines flickering across. lines = [(html_text_plain, t_start, frames_per_char)].

name: find_hop
doc:
REF-2 69.6-72.4s "platform hop": one input keeps typing while the site under it cuts
(Google -> Facebook -> YouTube -> Twitter -> ChatGPT). Here it is a browser find bar
searching each real page for the thing he says is missing: "aurora — 0/0". pages =
[(src, t_cut)], each a full-frame capture; one click per page cut.

name: broll
doc:
A real moving clip, edge to edge, never still: REF-1 runs a steady digital zoom of
4-7.5%/s on 62 of 79 shots (in on faces and objects, out on composites), and opens new
interview cuts defocused, sharpening over ~9 frames (focus_in=9). punches = [(t, scale)]
hard punch-ins on a word. Transform AND filter both reach the renderer on <video>
(tested 2026-10-20).

name: overlay
doc: A texture clip over everything: light leak (screen), glitch noise (normal, 2-4 frames).

name: neg_flash
doc:
REF-1's invert: ONE negative frame, then ONE overexposed bloom frame, then the shot.
ids = the elements on screen at t (videos included — filters reach the renderer).

name: finish
doc:
The overlays every image beat sits under: thirds grid (scaled with the push in
REF-1, here static) and the vignette.

name: seq
doc:
items = [(src, t_on)] each shown until the next (the last until t_end). Every image is pushed
(REF: nothing sits still) and gets a click on its frame. rot = max random rotation (deg) for the
semantic-object strobes (REF-3 money strobe: small rotate/push per image). white_box: one white
frame before each image (REF-2 pop).

name: vseq
doc: items = [(src, t_on, media_start)] — moving footage cut on the words, a click per cut.

name: pop_shatter
doc:
REF-2 0.00-1.16: cards pop one per word (a 1-frame white box of the card's size first, a click
each), the stack PULLS OUT ~11%, then breaks into white blocks: 2f blocky slabs, 1f white, 1f smear.
cards = [(src, x, y, w, rot, t_pop)] (x, y = centre).

name: whip_out
doc: the zoom accelerates with the subject over the last frames: x1.15, 1.30, 1.35, 1.83 + motion smear.

name: silence_cut
doc:
A rebuilt editor track of THIS take: the real waveform of `win` (seconds), the real silences
(silencedetect) flagged red, then snapped shut one by one at cut_at[k] — a click each, the rest of
the track sliding left (transform only).

name: edit_timeline
doc:
The real timeline of THIS video between view=(a,b): V1 = the actual shots (thumb per shot),
A1 = the spoken words as blocks at their onsets (+ waveform), FX = every sound cue. The playhead sweeps
`sweep`=(from,to) in comp seconds across the beat; each cut it crosses flashes a guide line down
to the word it lands on, with a click (REF: clicks land on the frame).

name: comment_box
doc:
A generic comment composer (no brand marks, no invented comments): avatar, the input line,
a blinking caret; optional text typing. "You tell me" = the empty box waiting for the viewer.

name: bed_wave
doc:
The music bed's real waveform, scrolling under a fixed centre line: at comp time t the
centre shows song time song_at + (t - t0). A symmetric peak plot, white on black.

name: filmstrip
doc:
Every shot of the video as a strip of frames racing past (REF-1's wall, flattened):
35mm-style perforations, a click as the strip starts.

name: player_window
doc:
This video, shrinking into a generic player in hard steps (REF-3's window-expand, reversed):
the frame is the video, and we're watching it inside itself. steps = [(frame_offset, scale)].
The <video> is a top-level clip (never inside a wrapper); the chrome is a separate clip above it.

name: calendar
doc:
A wall calendar of real months; each real release lands on its date as a chip (a 1-frame
white box first, a click each). months = [(year, month)], events = [(y, m, d, label, t_land)].

name: code_scroll
doc:
Real text (this build's own code, cue sheet, render log) scrolling up in a dark editor pane.
lines = list of (html) strings. hl = (row, t) puts the marker on one row.

name: slap_caps
doc:
The generic auto-caption look the line mocks (made for this video): one heavy uppercase word at a
time, marker-yellow with a thick black stroke, each SLAPPED on (scale 1.45 -> 0.96 -> 1 over 3 frames,
a small tilt), a click each. items = [(word, t)]; big = the word that lands bigger.

name: img_mark
doc: A real brand mark as (keeps its own colours: the Claude spark stays clay, Gemini keeps its gradient). white=True turns a black mark white (invert). Blur-in over 6 frames like a key word.

name: cutout_world
doc:
REF-1 0-4.5s: the speaker (RVM matte from the RAW plate, never graded) standing still while the world behind swaps on
the words, each swap a tile-flash reveal. worlds = [(kind, src, t_on, still_for_tiles, media_start)]
kind = 'video'|'img'. mega = (text, t_on, y): the huge red word BEHIND the head.
Layer order: world (z) -> tiles (z+1) -> mega (z+10) -> matte (z+20).

name: double_neg
doc:
REF-2 D19, into every chapter: the last 2 frames of the outgoing shot inverted + the first 2 of the
incoming inverted.

name: triptych
doc:
REF-1 S70: the three people of the line side by side (vertical panels here; a diagonal seam
would need clip-path on <video>, which the renderer is not proven to honour). vids = [(src, media_start)].
Each panel is its own top-level <video> in frame px, opening defocused (rack in, 6 frames).

name: page_card
doc:
A real page edge to edge: opens defocused and racks sharp (REF-1 9.9s), pushes slowly, and the
highlighter sweeps each measured box in turn (marks = [[x,y,w,h]] in 1920x1080 px, from OCR / DOM),
`step` frames apart, a soft click each. Marks live inside the pushed container so they stay on the words.

name: captions_switch
doc:
REF-2: the caption turns black on light pages and white on dark ones, in the same slots. words =
[(text, onset)]; segs = [(t_start, t_end, 'ink'|'white')]. Every seg lays out ALL the words (so nothing
re-centres) and shows those already spoken. Ink gets a paper halo so it reads over page text.
